title: Sort Characters By Frequency

story.title: The Most Popular Letters
story.text: Letter tiles are counted into lockers, then a pyramid with the most common letter on top hands out tiles: all copies of the top letter go first, then the next.
story.goal: Return the string sorted by how often each letter appears, most frequent first.

hints: Any order of equally frequent letters is accepted on LeetCode; the tests here have no ties.
